subject: planner: fix the issue of reusing wrong point-plan for "select ... for update" (#54661)
summary: Adds txn/autocommit (and pessimistic-autocommit config) state into plan-cache keys and guards the PointGet fast-path reuse with a stored cache key, preventing reuse of a PointGet plan built under a different transaction state (notably SELECT ... FOR UPDATE). Resets cached PointGet state on schema change and adds regression tests for the scenario.
